ITEM 1 | Scrambled material, pale yellow to golden with darker yellow patches, soft and fluffy with small curds and irregular clumps, slightly moist sheen, spread across the upper left of the plate in a footprint about 11 cm by 9 cm, piled to roughly 2 cm high in the center, no visible browning | 130
ITEM 2 | Small cylindrical pieces, reddish-brown to dark brown with a glossy, slightly wrinkled skin, firm and holding their shape, some with darker charred or caramelized spots, about 2.5 to 3 cm long and 2 cm wide, clustered together in a pile at the bottom center of the plate, sitting directly on the plate surface and touching each other | 150
